observation: Harvard dates edX and HarvardX to 2012 and the launch of Harvard Online to 2022.
2U reported completing its acquisition of substantially all edX assets.
Harvard’s vice provost describes HarvardX as a university initiative. The edX partner catalogue continues to list Harvard courses.
edX describes its audit period as temporary. Audit availability and duration depend on the course. Graded assessments generally require the paid track.
Yale lists two revised courses transferred to Coursera, Craig Wright’s music course and Ian Shapiro’s politics course. Yale supplies no migration date on this page.
Harvard’s open site lists the lecture sequence, practice, syllabus and final project.
The ancient Greek course opens its study sections without enrollment. The OU asks for sign-in for some quizzes, activities and progress tracking.
